The Chinese characters for Sean

As a transliteration, Sean is usually written 肖恩 (Xiào ēn). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

Sean comes from Irish and means “God is gracious (form of John)”.

About the name Sean

The Irish form of John, carried by the actor Sean Connery.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Sean carries the meaning “God is gracious (form of John)” and looks striking in brush strokes.
